items.passageEn: Sam is the new student in my class. At first, some students did not like his manner. He seemed cold, and he never smiled. But I soon learned he was just shy. Everyone was surprised by his intelligence, and he helps anyone who has difficulty with math. Later, he told me he hated being the new student. Now he feels comfortable in our class, and we are good friends.
items.passageZh: Sam 是我們班的新同學。一開始，有些同學不喜歡他的舉止。他看起來很冷淡，也從來不笑。但我很快就發現他只是害羞。他的聰明讓大家都很驚訝，他也會幫助任何數學有困難的人。後來他跟我說，他很討厭當新同學。現在他在我們班已經很自在了，我們也成了好朋友。

questions.questionZh: 一開始為什麼有些同學不喜歡 Sam？
options: 他上課很吵，常常打斷老師說話
他看起來很冷淡，從來不笑

referenceEn: He has a very good attitude at work.
His attitude toward work is very good.
rubricZh: 「態度」用 attitude（例如 a good attitude、his attitude toward work）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 He has、His attitude is）

items.promptZh: 我女兒非常迷那個歌手。
referenceEn: My daughter is crazy about that singer.
My daughter is really crazy about that singer.
rubricZh: 用 be crazy about 表示「非常迷…」
主詞是單數，be 動詞用 is
